LanguageData.LP_ExtractDemonBlood.label: draw demon blood
LanguageData.LP_ExtractDemonBlood.description: Draw a vial of demon blood from a demon prisoner wearing a planar anchor chain and held in a room with a binding circle. Not lethal; once every 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_MakeDimensionalShackles.label: forge planar anchor chain
LanguageData.LP_MakeDimensionalShackles.description: Forge a planar anchor chain from 30 silver, 20 cold iron and 2 planar residue.
